the STA PowerShell/COM worker source and its shell-free encoded command
supervising the blocking worker, collecting its output, and independently cleaning the Rhino host it started

the execution receipt and its status

the OCCT implementation of the compiled-cad-execution interface: supported solid, extrusion, bounded planar surface, retained polyline curve, capped or uncapped polyline loft, circular revolve, boolean and linear array operations; exact STEP write/readback and tessellated mesh and native curve .3dm preview from one model
native preview material assignment and readback for caller-declared component materials and existing FRAME/GLAZING role fallbacks, including actual glass transparency

the neutral CadBackend protocol, CadExecutionRequest, CadExecutionSource, CadArtifact and CadExecutionResult values, and the single CAD_BACKEND_REGISTRY; native evidence and retained receipt readers stay backend-specific

orthographic visible/hidden polylines of named STEP shapes with their source object ids (project_occt_lines): one exact HLRBRep_Algo solve over every selected shape in a caller-stated right/up frame, an exact near/far depth slab, chord-deflection discretization in the STEP read unit

plane-section extraction from the same selected shapes in the same frame (section_occt_lines, section_occt_regions): OcctDrawingPolyline values carry the section kind, and OcctDrawingRegion values carry each solid's closed material boundaries, including holes and disconnected cuts, to be filled even-odd

measuring explicitly requested final named solid pairs from OCCT shapes: true distance in metres and common solid volume in cubic metres, preserving separated/contact/penetrating/unchecked and never reconstructing consumed boolean operands

patching caller-supplied composed 3dm bytes from exact prior/current compiled programs and a native replacement preview, preserving unchanged objects and shared block/material tables with explicit unit conversion
verifying source OCCT STEP shape reuse for unchanged physical objects while rebuilding changed operations and required intermediate inputs
composed replacements without explicit donor materials inherit the same source object material or a unique source component material, preserving native PBR and textures

splitting one exported STEP into a single-object STEP per named shape, each re-read and measured against the shape it was written from (split_step_objects); identity is the STEP's own shape name, never import order or position

the import-based Rhino export: the host reads those files back one at a time instead of rebuilding, the saved document is compared with the source shapes' solids, faces, closure and volume inside the host before a completion marker exists, and the delivery's own retained materials are what the imported objects wear
one numbered speculative attempt directory inside a caller-supplied export workspace (work_model_workspace), and the reader's own cold check of a saved work model (verify_work_model_geometry)
read-only discovery of the PowerShell that supervises a host export when the caller configured none (discover_powershell); an explicit executable always wins and nothing is launched by discovery
one process-wide Rhino host lock: a candidate's export and an explicitly requested work export are the same machine resource and take the same lock

Blender solid and straight-extrusion meshes, explicit speculative .blend save in one background process, fresh-process geometry/semantic/binding readback, and the native retained receipt reader; no backend-specific project state

CadExecutionRequest with explicit artifact stem, material/layer maps, observer, optional verified source and backend option mapping; no repository handle
outputs: OcctExecutionReceipt: exact STEP and preview artifact identities, saved B-rep readback matched to declared solid or open-surface geometry, preview inspection, backend identity and measured timings
OcctDrawingPolyline values with object_id, visible/hidden/section kind and 2D points; no writes or receipt
OcctDrawingRegion values with object_id and closed 2D loops for one solid's section, filled together using even-odd; separate solids remain separate values
CadExecutionResult: backend id, exact binding, status, named verified artifacts, stable object/semantic coverage, failures and unchanged backend-specific receipt payload
BlenderExecutionReceipt@1: a native .blend mesh artifact and independent saved object/bounds/volume/unit/semantic/exact-binding readback; the common result has no 3dm inspection
invariants: a successful process exit is never sufficient - the saved file is read back independently and must match the denominator
the export identity refuses any up_axis but Z-up and any unit outside millimeter/meter/inch/foot
every path is constrained to the caller-supplied workspace; no shell interpolation and no launcher file exists

discovery is read-only: it never launches or attaches to Rhino

projection is a plain value: every selected object takes part in the one visibility solve (an object outside the near/far slab is excluded, one crossing it is cut there), each polyline names its object and its kind, output is sorted and deterministic, and nothing is written

sections intersect their actual B-reps with the requested plane rather than projecting bounds; material section loops connect shared B-rep vertices only, open cuts are never closed by proximity or invented edges, open surfaces and shells contribute no material region, and holes stay inside their solid's even-odd region while separate solids are filled separately

drawing origin/right/up are explicit in the CAD Z-up frame; right and up are orthonormal and right cross up faces the viewer; output coordinates and positive chord deflection share the source shape's unit; unknown, ambiguous or empty selected shapes and invalid frames fail explicitly

an import-based export rebuilds nothing: every object comes from the exact STEP this program already exported, each single-object file is bound to its digest in the plan and checked again in the host before it is read, and a file that changed in between is refused

an imported document is verified against the same program denominator as a rebuilt one, stated in the representation it actually delivers: no block definitions, and each named object delivered as the number of B-reps its count states
only one export drives this machine's Rhino at a time, and a caller that will not wait is told the host is busy rather than queued invisibly

the common result preserves native success/readback evidence and validates exact binding, semantic identity, workspace containment and artifact bytes; it is not a new retained receipt or write authority

Blender supports positive solids and straight extrusions of simple planar profiles in the initial slice; all other operations fail before host execution or workspace writes. Complete rebuilds preserve source artifacts; cached exact requests verify retained proof and bytes without starting a host

retained polyline curves are verified from cold STEP and native 3DM readback against all authored points, endpoints and length; curve delivery claims no face or solid, and existing solid/surface receipt fields retain their meaning
